tasks.label: Android: Assemble Debug
tasks.command: if (Test-Path .\gradlew.bat) { .\gradlew.bat :app:assembleDebug } elseif (Get-Command gradle -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { gradle :app:assembleDebug } else { Write-Error 'Gradle not found. Install Gradle or add the Gradle Wrapper.'; exit 1 }

tasks.label: Android: Run Unit Tests
tasks.command: if (Test-Path .\gradlew.bat) { .\gradlew.bat :app:testDebugUnitTest } elseif (Get-Command gradle -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest } else { Write-Error 'Gradle not found. Install Gradle or add the Gradle Wrapper.'; exit 1 }

tasks.label: Android: Install Debug on Device
tasks.command: if (Test-Path .\gradlew.bat) { .\gradlew.bat :app:installDebug } elseif (Get-Command gradle -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { gradle :app:installDebug } else { Write-Error 'Gradle not found. Install Gradle or add the Gradle Wrapper.'; exit 1 }
